notes:
Summary: enterprise adtech vendor evaluating Redwood for latency- and cost-sensitive realtime inference. Primary goal: replace brittle in-house microservices with unified inference layer to hit p50/p95 latency targets while cutting token cost via batching/caching/quantization recommendations.

Key quotes: "Need sub-120ms p50 for chat-based personalization at 200rps during peak events." - CTO.

Pain points: legacy CPU fallback adds 800ms+, ops overhead for multi-model routing, unpredictable token spend during peak. Very cost-sensitive for bulk embeddings + reranking.

Tech preferences: prefer model variants that can be quantized to 4-bit; open to Redwood-curated Llama3/Redwood-small for fallback. Want automatic KV/prefix caching for session-based UX.

Security/compliance: must support customer-managed KMS, SSO integration, audit logs with 1y retention, and option for on-prem air-gapped deployment for regulated clients.

Stakeholders: CTO (product lead), Head of ML (POC contact), Infra Eng manager, Procurement (legal review).

Full audit logs and KMS integration required for production. POC to include throughput and tail latency benchmarks, token-cost modelling, and smoke tests for failover routing.
